prompt:
GAME ITEM ICON. Camera above the object looking down at about sixty degrees, the way the game RimWorld draws loose items on the floor. One object, centred, filling about three quarters of the canvas.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite: the detached nose section of a guided missile, lying on its side. Images 1 and 2 are our approved item icons from the same family of parts: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

A short, thick olive-drab steel cylinder, about twice as long as it is wide, with a rounded clear glass dome at the front end showing a small dark sensor inside, a thin bright metal ring where the dome meets the body, and an open back end with a round connector plate and a few short coloured wires.

Draw ONLY this, alone on a plain pure white background.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, fins, wings, flames, text, letters, numbers, logos, floor, ground or cast shadow.
